_about: Hand-written test set for the HTB Cheatsheet Assistant. `expected_machines` is a hand-derived answer key built by grepping the RAW write-ups (data/raw), NOT by trusting the RAG system. It lists machines that genuinely demonstrate the technique; it is a high-precision (not necessarily exhaustive) key used to measure retrieval recall/precision. `must_mention` lists key terms a good synthesized answer should contain.

questions.question: Provide me the Windows privilege escalation cheatsheet.
questions.note: Broad. Any strong subset of potato-family / ADCS / token-abuse machines counts; scored on overlap.
